== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Dagobah [[Flagship]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Flagship (Dagobah)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Membership is every verified existing article in this Dagobah family. Same name + same picture + same card type (#583). Reflections Gold same-name/different-picture cards are a separate lineage. Virtual headings follow each article's |set=. Do not invent printings.
</noinclude>
